key_insight: Łojasiewicz-type gradient domination enables stochastic gradient descent convergence-rate analysis beyond convexity, explicitly accounting for bounded, decaying, and polynomially controlled noise.
engineering_relevance: The results can help assess SGD convergence guarantees in nonconvex optimization when gradient noise changes over time.
method: Assume a Łojasiewicz-type gradient domination condition.
Analyze convergence rates almost surely and in expectation.
Track how noise asymptotics affect rates and applicability.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports theoretical convergence results extending prior noise assumptions, but describes no datasets or empirical evaluations.
watch_item: Applying the guarantees requires verifying the gradient domination and noise-control assumptions for the target problem.
paper_title: Convergence rate of stochastic gradient descent under Łojasiewicz type condition and polynomially controlled noise
